title: A run that succeeds without leaving a disposition must never be auto-replayed

incident.mechanism: a run exits 0 with no disposition -> the server's successful-run handoff creates a corrective run -> the reasoning is paid for again. Both recorded cost incidents are this class. Paperclip bounds it at DEFAULT_MAX_SUCCESSFUL_RUN_HANDOFF_ATTEMPTS = 1; the factory must never widen it by classifying such a run as cheap to retry.

trigger: a run with status succeeded, no livenessState and no nextAction
assertion: classified reasoning, autoReplaySafe false; and an unknown failure code defaults to the same, never to transport
